title.narrative: Kanifing Environmental Transformation Programme (KETP): Using a sustainable focus on new integrated waste management approaches to drive environmental, social and economic transformation in Kanifing.

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of this action is to strengthen urban governance, inclusive service delivery, and sustainable resource management of Kanifing municipality through the deployment of innovative technologies and exchange of best practices with Peterborough City Council to drive environmental, social, and economic transformation and accelerate the achievement of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

description.narrative: Indicator: 1.6.1 Area of urban green provided or restored in target city with support of the EUfunded intervention ( number of trees planted).There will 190, 000 tree planted in the municipality

comment.narrative: This year seven wards namely Old Bakau Bakau New Town Old Jeshwang Tallinding South and Tallinding North participated in the communitybased tree planting exercise. 67000 tree seedlings were planted in the municipality during the period under review. Out of the 67 000 tree seedlings 22 500 trees were planted in communities where residents had requested their planting 44 000 mangrove seedlings were planted along riverine areas to restore mangrove plantation and 500 tree seedlings were planted along highway in Bakau.

title.narrative: Indicator: 1.2.1 Number of primary school teachers reporting new knowledge on sustainable living practices, disaggregated by sex.

description.narrative: Teachers will be trained on sustainable living practices and circular economy processes with the aim for them to become conveyors of the initiative to the schoolage children and trigger a new generation of behavioural change agents.

comment.narrative: The consultant has developed and submitted the copies of the six training modules for the Teach the Teacher program on environmental sustainability. Below are the modules.1.Module 1 Sustainable Development Goal SDG2.Module 2 Climate Change Mitigation Adaptation3.Module 3 Integrated Waste management 4.Module 4 Water Sanitation and Hygiene5.Module 5 Ecosystem and Biodiversity conservation6.Module 6 Waste management for sustainability for sustainable living practices and circular economy.Subsequently the project carried out five days training for 100 teachers from both primary and secondary school on sustainable living practices using the modules. The participants were all provided with the training materials and were also given certificates at the end of the training. For visibility purpose banners were displayed photographs taken and TShirts were printed and supplied to the participants and resource persons
